meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 可以创建、读取、处理和操作 AnnData 对象（.h5ad 等格式），支持单细胞数据中的子集、合并、转换、压缩存储等操作。
howto.when: 当你提到“h5ad”、“AnnData”、“单细胞分析”等关键词，或要求处理 .h5ad 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取 data.h5ad 文件，并展示 obs 表。
say.note: Claude 会读取该文件并返回 obs 表内容。

say.text: 将这两个 AnnData 对象按 obs 合并，标记批次来源。
过滤 obs 中 cell_type 为 T cell 的行，并保存为新文件。
say.note: Claude 会子集并写入 h5ad。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can create, read, process, and manipulate AnnData objects (.h5ad, zarr, etc.), supporting subsetting, concatenation, transformation, compression, and various I/O operations for annotated data matrices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "h5ad", "AnnData", "single-cell analysis", or request handling of .h5ad files.

say_en.text: Read data.h5ad and show the obs table.
say_en.note: Claude reads the file and displays the obs table.

say_en.text: Concatenate these two AnnData objects along obs, labeling batch.
say_en.note: Claude uses ad.concat with batch labels.

say_en.text: Filter obs where cell_type is 'T cell' and save to a new file.
say_en.note: Claude subsets and writes to h5ad.
